svg.title: Jev classifier: Qwen backbone and A/B readout
svg.desc: Policy, dialogue history, and a candidate reply form a non-thinking prompt. Native token embeddings feed the 28 decoder layers of Qwen3-0.6B; only Attention and FFN are shown inside the decoder. The final prompt token state passes through the native language-model head to produce vocabulary scores. A/B scores are selected and normalized into compliant or violating probabilities. LLaMA-Factory trains all model parameters with cross-entropy restricted to A/B. Silver denotes reused model components; blue denotes task readout and supervision.
